;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Tembin (2017)|Tropical Storm Tembin]]
***More than 200 people are dead in the southern [[Philippines]] as a result of floods and mudslides caused by Severe Tropical Storm Vinta. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-asia-storm-philippines/nearly-90-dead-in-philippine-mudslides-flooding-as-storm-hits-officials-idUSKBN1EH05A (Reuters)]
*[[London Zoo|London Zoo fire]]
**A fire breaks out at a café and shop at the [[London Zoo]]. An [[aardvark]] is killed and four [[meerkat]]s are missing. [https://news.sky.com/story/london-zoo-fire-70-firefighters-tackle-cafe-blaze-11181845 (Sky)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-fire-zoo/aardvark-dies-in-blaze-at-london-zoo-meerkats-missing-idUSKBN1EH08I (Reuters)]
*[[December 2017 Southern California wildfires]]
**The [[Thomas Fire]] becomes the [[List of California wildfires#Largest fires|largest]] in [[California]]n state history. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42464835 (BBC)]
*[[2017 Davao City mall fire]]
**Thirty-seven people, mostly [[call centre]] workers, are missing and presumed dead in a fire in the [[Davao City]] Mall in the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/896241/Philippines-fire-mall-Davao-City-flames (''The Express'')] [http://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/37-feared-dead-in-philippine-mall-blaze/1192687 (''The Free Press Journal'')]
*Thirty-three people are killed and 15 injured as a bus falls 65 feet into the [[Banas River|river]] in [[Rajasthan]], [[Western India]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/more-than-30-dead-after-bus-veers-off-bridge-in-india-11181844 (Sky News)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of France]]
**French President [[Emmanuel Macron]] says he will help strengthen the military forces of the [[G5 Sahel]] fighting Islamist militants in the [[Northern Mali conflict]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-sahel/macron-france-ready-to-strengthen-force-in-sahel-fighting-islamists-idUSKBN1EH0JX?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*A [[mail carrier]] from [[Dublin, Ohio]], (told that he would lose his job) allegedly kills 2 of his supervisors. [http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/police-ohio-postal-worker-kills-boss-postal-inspector-51969085 (AP via ABC News)]  [http://www.dispatch.com/news/20171223/police-naked-carrier-kills-supervisor-in-dublin-post-office-then-kills-another-co-worker (''The Columbus Dispatch'')]

;Politics and elections
*Previously secret documents from [[Alan Ewen Donald]], the [[List of ambassadors of the United Kingdom to China|United Kingdom's ambassador to China]] between 1988 and 1991, regarding the [[Tiananmen Square protests of 1989]], are released after being declassified in October, putting the death toll from the protests at 10,000 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-42465516 (BBC)]
*Former [[Peru]] president [[Alberto Fujimori]] is taken, from prison, to a local hospital for treatment for abnormally [[Hypotension|low blood pressure]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-peru-fujimori/perus-fujimori-taken-to-hospital-from-prison-in-ambulance-local-tv-idUSKBN1EH0QD?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2017–18 La Liga]] 
**For a record third time in a row, [[FC Barcelona]] wins the [[El Clásico]] [[Road (sports)|away]] match versus [[Real Madrid C.F.]]. With a 3–0 score, they extend their lead over Real Madrid at the top of [[La Liga]] to 14 points. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2017/dec/23/real-madrid-v-barcelona-el-clasico-live (''The Guardian'')]
